title: The Captain's Boots
summary: Captain Hale's boots are dusty every morning, and he swears he never leaves his bed. Juniper has noticed. Somebody ought to find out where he goes.

stages.text: Follow the Captain at night and see where he walks.
Now you know. Put a stop to the walking before he walks too far.

objectives.text: Fetch bellwort root for Juniper's wakeful tea.

resolutions.journal: A cup of Juniper's wakeful tea, not the sleep draught, and the Captain slept the whole night in his own bed. His boots were clean by morning.
You asked, and Hale agreed, red to the ears, to be tied to his bedpost with a soft rope. He does not speak of it. He does not need to.
A little brass bell on his door. He woke to it at the Bell Line stones, confused, and went back to bed. It is not a cure, but it is a start.
You followed him the whole way and learned the route he walks. It runs through Briarwood, and it is a better road to the priory than any map shows.

failures.journal: The sleep draught was the wrong bottle. Hale walked past the Bell Line stones and did not turn back. Juniper will not look at you.
